settings.downloaders.catTransmission: Stored as a Transmission label; Transmission 4 or newer is required.

settings.downloaders.folderNamesHint: When the Downloader sees the folder under another path
settings.downloaders.name: Name
settings.downloaders.addressHint: Its web page. For SABnzbd, use the IP or allow HolyArrs' host name.

settings.downloaders.failPrograms: Fail downloads that hold programs or fakes
